GordonRyan - SystematicallyAttackingTheK.overview: Gordon Ryan's kimura course in eight volumes, organised by position. Volume 1 covers the overview and mechanics. Volume 2 covers the kimura from open guard (the 'power kimura'). Volume 3 covers half guard (reactive versus proactive locks). Volume 4 covers top open guard (collar tie set-ups). Volume 5 covers side control and north-south (the 'powerline'). Volume 6 covers mount (failed underhook to kimura). Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
GordonRyan - SystematicallyAttackingTheK.for: No-gi grapplers who want the kimura as a submission and a control tool.
